stories.title: A good tire can be the difference between a crash and a near miss: Consumer Reports Best Tires of 2026
stories.summary: You only have four tires, four areas about the size of your palm, touching the road, so tires are the most important part of safety in your vehicle.

stories.title: College GameDay coming to Winston-Salem for Wake Forest-Duke game
stories.summary: The Duke-Wake Forest game is scheduled for Saturday, Nov. 28, at Allegacy Financial Stadium. Kickoff is expected to be at 3:30 p.m.

stories.title: North Carolina certifies most election results as Guilford County House race remains under recount
stories.summary: Shelly Headen gained one vote in Tuesday's hand-to-eye recount sample as the Guilford County race remains uncertified.

stories.title: Police: Man arrested for exposing himself to preteen at a High Point Walmart
stories.summary: A Thomasville man faces a felony charge for allegedly exposing himself to a child at a Walmart yesterday.

stories.title: Winston-Salem warning residents about invoice email scam
stories.summary: The city advises residents and businesses to watch for warning signs, including unexpected payment demands, urgent requests for money, and unfamiliar links.

stories.title: Bennett College sells historic painting for more than $14 million at auction
stories.summary: Bennett College sold an Aaron Douglas painting of Harriet Tubman for $14.5 million, with proceeds supporting the college's growth and women's health initiative.

stories.title: Gov. Stein announces new pharmaceutical manufacturing facility to bring $125 million investment to Guilford County
stories.summary: Project Dove will bring a new pharmaceutical manufacturing facility and 240 jobs to Guilford County through a $125 million investment.

stories.title: Family of 2-year-old who died before Greensboro dental procedure files lawsuit
stories.summary: The complaint accuses Valleygate Dental Surgery Center and others of medical malpractice and negligence.

stories.title: Archdale police investigate break-in, theft at Kings BBQ and Burgers
stories.summary: Police are looking for the suspect involved in the restaurant break-in.

stories.title: Summerfield park restrooms vandalized twice in one week
stories.summary: The Guilford County Sheriff’s Office is increasing patrols after two incidents of vandalism at Community Park.

stories.title: Stokes County commissioners approve agreement with developer of proposed data center
stories.summary: Stokes County commissioners will move forward with a developer for their proposed data center.

stories.title: Justice sought for Mebane mother killed after hit-and-run crash in Durham County
stories.summary: A Mebane family mourns the tragic loss of Windy Gaskill after a hit-and-run in Durham County, as they and state troopers urge the driver to come forward.
